retrievalProfile.description: A surrealist portrait featuring a central face framed by multiple hands and secondary faces emerging from deep shadows in a warm, low-key lighting scheme.
triggerTerms: low-key warm portrait with dark background
excludeWhen: modern digital flat design is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, direct-gaze portrait of a man, tightly framed by several pairs of hands with manicured nails. Additional partial faces of the same subject appear to sprout or emerge from the sides and top, creating a kaleidoscopic, psychological effect against a solid black void.
coreVisualRelationships: Central face as the primary focal point
Hands acting as a rhythmic, circular frame
Secondary faces creating a sense of motion or multiplicity
High contrast between warm skin tones and deep black background
coreInvariants: Direct eye contact from the central face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary face is centered and large-scale, occupying the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes of the central face provide the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye follows the circle of hands around the central face, then moves outward to the secondary faces.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of black negative space at the corners and background to emphasize the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black background for high contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft pink or mauve on the fingernails.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with low overall color saturation, leaning into earthy browns and golds.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm earth tones and black

characterSpecificRedesigns: Interlocking or overlapping characters in the subtitle to create a 'linked' effect

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed over the dark hair/background area
Overlapping the top of the subject's head

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold white sans-serif for the name paired with a tighter, colored decorative sans for the title.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the geometric 70s soul aesthetic perfectly.
Provides the necessary geometric weight for the main name.
Offers the slightly decorative geometric feel for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-key portrait of a man with warm skin tones against a black background. Use a composite effect where multiple hands frame his face and secondary faces emerge from the shadows in a radial pattern.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply bold, white geometric sans-serif text at the top center. Below it, add a second line of text in pale yellow with very tight tracking so the letters nearly touch.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting warm and low-key?
Are the hands arranged in a framing circle around the face?
Is the typography centered and uppercase?

mustRedesign: Avoid any specific artist names or logos
Do not replicate the exact 'Spring' record label logo

mustAchieve: Seamless blending of hands and faces

postGenerationChecks: Check for anatomical correctness of the hands
Ensure the text is legible against the dark background
Verify the '70s soul' color palette is maintained
Confirm the central face has a direct, neutral gaze
recipe.reuseFormula: Surrealist Portrait + Radial Hand Framing + Low-Key Warm Lighting + Geometric 70s Typography
